questions.stem: A 29 y/o woman visits the doctor with symptoms of itching, burning, and a thick white vaginal discharge. She has no significant past history and is not on any medications. Examination shows erythema and swelling of the vulva and vagina, along with a curd-like discharge. A wet mount of the discharge reveals budding yeast and pseudohyphae. What is the suggested initial treatment for this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Metronidazole 500 mg orally twice a day for 7 days

options.label: B
options.text: Fluconazole 150 mg orally as a single dose

options.label: D
options.text: Fluconazole 300 mg orally as two split doses 72 hrs apart
